static float g_angle = 0.0f;

--- display_header ---
void display() {
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
  float A[8], B[8], C[8];
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -9.5000f);
  glRotatef(28.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- source ---
  static float incl, th, px, py, pz;
  func0(rad, tilt) {
    glBegin(GL_LINE_LOOP);
      for(i, 0, 64) {
        glVertex3f(cos(i*TAU/64)*rad, sin(i*TAU/64)*rad*sin(tilt), sin(i*TAU/64)*rad*cos(tilt));
      }
    glEnd();
  }
  glClearColor(0.02, 0.02, 0.05, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  // faint orbit rings (unlit lines); func0 = one inclined ring
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glColor3f(0.22, 0.24, 0.34);
  glLineWidth(1.2);
  func0(1.3, 0.18);
  func0(2.1, 0.06);
  func0(2.9, 0.0);
  func0(3.7, 0.22);
  // the sun: drawn unlit so it glows (it sits on the SOLAR light at origin)
  glColor3f(1, 0.85, 0.3);
  glutSolidSphere(0.5, 24, 24);
  glColor3f(1, 0.9, 0.5);
  glRasterPos3f(0.6, 0.55, 0);
  label("Sun");
  // planets: lit by the central SOLAR light, color via glColor
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  // Mercury (0.38 Earth radii)
  incl = 0.18;
  th = t*1.6;
  px = cos(th)*1.3;
  py = sin(th)*1.3*sin(incl);
  pz = sin(th)*1.3*cos(incl);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glColor3f(0.7, 0.6, 0.5);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(px, py, pz);
    glutSolidSphere(0.069, 16, 16);
  glPopMatrix();
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glColor3f(0.9, 0.75, 0.6);
  glRasterPos3f(px + 0.12, py + 0.14, pz);
  label("Mercury");
  // Venus (0.95 Earth radii)
  incl = 0.06;
  th = t*1.15 + 1.0;
  px = cos(th)*2.1;
  py = sin(th)*2.1*sin(incl);
  pz = sin(th)*2.1*cos(incl);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glColor3f(0.95, 0.8, 0.5);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(px, py, pz);
    glutSolidSphere(0.171, 16, 16);
  glPopMatrix();
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glColor3f(1, 0.9, 0.65);
  glRasterPos3f(px + 0.14, py + 0.16, pz);
  label("Venus");
  // Earth (1.0, the reference radius)
  incl = 0.0;
  th = t*0.85 + 2.5;
  px = cos(th)*2.9;
  py = sin(th)*2.9*sin(incl);
  pz = sin(th)*2.9*cos(incl);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glColor3f(0.35, 0.55, 1);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(px, py, pz);
    glutSolidSphere(0.18, 16, 16);
  glPopMatrix();
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glColor3f(0.6, 0.8, 1);
  glRasterPos3f(px + 0.16, py + 0.18, pz);
  label("Earth");
  // Mars (0.53 Earth radii)
  incl = 0.22;
  th = t*0.62 + 4.0;
  px = cos(th)*3.7;
  py = sin(th)*3.7*sin(incl);
  pz = sin(th)*3.7*cos(incl);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glColor3f(0.9, 0.45, 0.3);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(px, py, pz);
    glutSolidSphere(0.096, 16, 16);
  glPopMatrix();
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glColor3f(1, 0.6, 0.45);
  glRasterPos3f(px + 0.13, py + 0.15, pz);
  label("Mars");
  // live readout: Earth's orbital phase, anchored in 3D below the system
  glColor3f(0.75, 0.8, 0.9);
  glRasterPos3f(-1.6, -3, 0);
  label("Earth phase = %f", fmod(t*0.85 + 2.5, TAU));
